_comment: Flash sequence profile for this project's own BM -> FBL -> APP boot chain (STM32F103C8T6). Functional addressing 0x700(tx)/0x600(rx), 500 kbit/s - see FBL/Src/UDS_CFG/UDS_config.h and Common_Src/HAL_CAN/HAL_CAN.c. Canonical copy of this file also lives in the CAN_FLASH tool's own profiles/ directory so it shows up in its Profile dropdown.
name: HUB Bootloader
description: APP/FBL UDS flash sequence for this project's own BM/FBL/APP boot chain.

security._comment: APP and FBL both implement levels 1-4 (seed/key pairs 0x01/0x02, 0x03/0x04, 0x05/0x06, 0x07/0x08 - see APP_SECURITY_LEVEL_*_SEED/_KEY in APP/Src/UDS_CFG/UDS_config.h and FBL_SECURITY_LEVEL_*_SEED/_KEY in xCOMMON_MODULES/Src/FBL/FBL.h), all sharing one placeholder algorithm - four doors to one room, not graded access. APP also gates the Programming session transition itself on security (unlike the generic SLP3 order), hence before_programming.

sequence._comment_erase: ROUTINE_ID_ERASE_MEMORY (FBL/Src/UDS_CFG/UDS_config.h) - FBL's handler ignores any request payload and always erases the whole configured APP region, so no address/size needed.
sequence._comment_fingerprint: APP/FBL do not implement 0x2E WriteDataByIdentifier (cut for size - see FBL/Src/UDS_CFG/UDS_config.h's file header) - sending it would abort the flash with serviceNotSupported.
sequence._comment_checksum: FBL has no per-segment checksum routine, only a whole-region one (see routine_validate_all).
sequence._comment_validate: ROUTINE_ID_CHECK_MEMORY (FBL/Src/UDS_CFG/UDS_config.h) - returns a live CRC32 over the whole APP region for the tester to compare; this tool currently only checks that the request itself didn't NRC, it doesn't compare the returned CRC against the flashed image.
